external_source.role: private one-time fixed global research baseline; published sensitometry/spectral proxy rather than paired stock evidence

execution_amendments.finding: The first common Adobe RGB matrix used a slightly different D65 normalization than the project's W3C sRGB matrix, causing a synthetic white-point domain escape.
execution_amendments.action: Before any formal source pixel execution, derive Adobe RGB 1998 matrices from its standard primaries and the exact same D65 xy; preserve every scientific gate and the strict domain policy.

execution_amendments.finding: A parallel runner review found that downloaded LUTs were verified externally but the runner itself rechecked only byte sizes.
execution_amendments.action: Stop the partial run before any report, remove its exact owned run_a tree, bind the source manifest SHA-256, recompute each Git blob SHA-1 and SHA-256 inside the runner, then restart both formal runs from empty directories without changing pixels, candidates, roles or gates.

visual_review.reason: The frozen protocol opens visual review only after every automatic gate passes; automatic separation and boundary gates failed.

interpretation: The fixed published global baseline creates a very large Velvia-versus-negative separation, but it makes Portra 400 and Ektar 100 less distinct than the existing weak RF3.D0 proxies and produces material Adobe-RGB-to-sRGB out-of-gamut clipping, especially for Velvia. The exact Classic_Normal display-derived control therefore closes without exposure, gamut-map, paper, look, gamma or threshold rescue. This does not evaluate PoLUT in its intended scene-referred raw-development workflow and does not falsify its physical construction. It does show that the unchanged public LUTs cannot be adopted as the project's bounded three-stock sRGB baseline on this input rail.
next_leaf: Return to rights-cleared controlled same-scene stock acquisition and independently grouped target evidence. Do not replace RF3.D11 with another PoLUT variant or another proxy family on this cohort.
claim_ceiling: One-time mechanics, separation and bounded safety evidence for three fixed public PoLUT Classic_Normal LUT controls on 16 identical CC0 display-derived source approximations. No target-film closeness, stock distinguishability, calibration, stock response, population preference, general PoLUT quality, product dependency or multi-stock completion claim.
